# Source Code Pro

The upright variable font from [adobe-fonts/source-code-pro](https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-code-pro),
release `2.042R-u/1.062R-i/1.026R-vf` (commit `d3f1a5962cde503f9409c21e58527611d4a19ef1`),
file `VF/SourceCodeVF-Upright.ttf`, unmodified. `LICENSE.md` is upstream's.

Embedded by `drip-gui` as its monospace font.
